generation_fact: One atomic relation established by a concrete execution: exact source information, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, formed outcome, and relation role; its identities and formation are not inferred from equal values.
generation_occurrence: One concrete execution that can establish several distinct generation facts; the occurrence is linked to each fact but is not interchangeable with any fact or outcome.
atomic_generation_fact: Each occurrence-established source/transformation/occurrence/outcome/role relation remains a separate atomic fact, preserving the exact incidences recorded for that execution.
realizes_fact: A primitive edge from an occurrence to the particular generation fact that the occurrence established.
reads_from: A primitive record of an actual data dependency; it must not be inferred merely from execution order, timestamps, or numeric similarity.
GeneratedOrigin: A primitive incidence allowing a previously formed outcome, with its exact identity, to serve as source information for a later generation fact.
program_order: A declared ordering between occurrences; by itself it establishes neither data dependency nor concurrency or non-concurrency.
equal_values: Numerically equal values do not identify equal facts, occurrences, sources, results, or formation histories, and equal outputs do not establish equal formation.
cartesian_recombination: Facts from one or more occurrences must not be split into source and result sets and recombined by Cartesian product; only each recorded atomic source-to-outcome formation may be followed.
missing_relations: An unrecorded relation means it was not established by the available graph; absence alone does not prove falsity, and absence of a concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: Follow exact source and result identities through the declared training chain: training sample to batch occurrence to forward occurrence to loss to backward occurrence to gradient to optimizer occurrence to the new parameter version, using primitive facts/incidences and explicit traversal rules for any derived relation.
reverse_query: Begin at the exact evaluation or parameter result and traverse backward only through its actual reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, and incidence relations; never substitute timestamp proximity or numeric similarity.
executable_claim: The sealed executable mechanism is the scientific authority: it must update from allowed prefix state and generate unseen continuous execution without future access; the report explains and cites it but cannot replace it.
state_sufficiency: Test operational closure by finding equal or sufficiently similar proposed (state, declared input) cases and checking for materially incompatible next state or outcome; search graph variables, continuing evolution, and unrepresentable transitions for counterexamples, enlarging or revising state when one is found rather than minimizing state cosmetically.
prefix_only_falsification: At multiple historical cuts before, near, and after candidate transitions, expose only the prefix, initialize from it, predict a later hidden suffix interval, compare prospectively with recorded facts, retain failures, and revise or reject the mechanism; a full-run fit is not this test.
report_code_correspondence: Map every forecast-affecting report claim to exact primitive GFG evidence, an executable state field or justified elimination, and a concrete update expression; every executable field must be updated or be a prefix-derived frozen constant, so narrative mechanisms cannot be silently replaced by a smaller clock trend.
operational_state_use: Field presence, reading, serialization, reporting, or carry-forward is not operational use: identify the exact expression by which each claimed control field can alter a required forecast, then perturb, remove, or hold it fixed in prefix-only replay and relabel inert fields as diagnostics or revise the law.
intervention_state_audit: For an intervention, enumerate every mechanism state read or written by the affected operation, identify what the hook changes, freezes, or leaves evolving, propagate all differences through the executable law, and test permitted discovery prefixes; claim pure time translation only if every required state translates consistently.
cross_run_invariance: Treat a repeated one-run pattern only as a hypothesis: distinguish structural laws, prefix-inferred state, discovery-estimated parameters, and uncertainty; falsify fixed clocks, periods, amplitudes, rates, and increments with multiple prefix cuts and matched compressed-state/declared-input cases, retaining context when futures diverge. Passing within-run replay does not establish transport, which requires prospective sealing and testing on a distinct unseen continuous execution.
